name: Viego
notes: Sovereign's Domination (P) requires an enemy champion takedown to ever trigger, which never happens against a stationary dummy, so it contributes nothing and is omitted entirely.
Q's cast time is the engine's standard 0.25 s ability lockout, matching the dossier's quoted cast time.

The crit-scaling terms on Q's active thrust, Q's on-hit passive, and R's arrival damage are Riot's own continuous expected-value formulas (partial coefficients of 0.6 / 0.7 / 0.7 on crit chance times crit damage bonus), applied manually rather than through the engine's own crit multiplier; the second-strike (mark consumption) instead rolls a full standard crit, so it uses the engine's crit_mod handling.

Spectral Maw (W) is charged for the minimum time and recast immediately: its damage is fixed regardless of charge duration and only stun/range (irrelevant against a stationary dummy) scale with charge, so the charge is treated as instantaneous; the recast still resets the attack timer and applies the mark.

Harrowed Path (E) is cast on cooldown purely for its attack-speed buff, which is read as lasting the full 8 s mist duration even while Viego keeps attacking (only the movement speed/camouflage portion is stated to be interrupted by attacking or casting).

Heartbreaker (R) is cast at the opening and again whenever its cooldown allows within the fight; on arrival it deals its AD-ratio damage plus the missing-health bonus to the target, applies Blade of the Ruined King's on-hit effects (the passive rider and any pending mark consumption), and then issues Viego an automatic follow-up basic attack.

Every basic attack applies Blade of the Ruined King's on-hit rider (percent current health, floored at its minimum, capable of a partial crit), and additionally consumes any pending mark for the second strike (full crit-capable, on-hit but not ability-tagged damage) left by Q's active or W.
None of Viego's abilities cost mana or energy, so no resource pool is modeled.
The monster damage cap on Q's on-hit rider is not applied since the dummy counts as an enemy champion.
